evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any special instructions concerns or stressors about moving in general or about this move that you need me to take note of at this time?' — asked after full logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer disclosed a mild, real concern ('we've just never moved like this, long-distance, before') but rep's response was a brief generic reassurance rather than genuine two-layer digging into what specifically worried her about the long-distance move — scored as shallow/attempted (8), not full, since a real concern was on the table and deserved more exploration.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Clear pay-less-if-faster framing repeated multiple times, plus 'get you locked in' language functioning as a rate-lock-style reassurance; missing the explicit self-prep tip and fair-check.

top_strength: Outstanding rapport and consultative honesty — patiently walked a hesitant, comparison-shopping caller through pricing without pressure, even encouraged her to check competitor reviews. Delivered the quid-pro-quo framing well ('just need to ask you some questions...to provide a personalized estimate') and all three key differentiators.
coaching_note: The 'first time moving long-distance' disclosure was a real opening for a deeper Stage 1 dig (what specifically worries you about that?) that got a generic reassurance instead — small miss in an otherwise excellent call.
